coveragePercentageTooltip: Shows what percentage of Gram Panchayats (GPs) have data available. Formula: (GPs with Data / Total GPs) × 100. Example: If 800 out of 1000 GPs have data, coverage = 80%.
totalGpMasterDataTooltip: Total count of Gram Panchayats that have master data records available in the system.
villageGpDataCoverageTooltip: Percentage of GPs with available master data. Formula: (GPs with Data / Total GPs) × 100.
totalFundsSanctionedTooltip: Total amount of funds sanctioned across all GPs for SBMG schemes and sanitation projects.
totalWorkOrderAmountTooltip: Total monetary value of all work orders issued for sanitation and waste management projects.
sbmgTargetAchievementRateTooltip: Overall achievement rate for SBMG schemes. Formula: (Total Achievement / Total Target) × 100. Example: 8,500 achieved out of 10,000 = 85%.
schemeAchievementPercentageTooltip: Achievement percentage for individual SBMG schemes. Formula: (Scheme Achievement / Scheme Target) × 100.
fundUtilizationRateTooltip: Percentage of sanctioned funds utilized through work orders. Formula: (Total Work Order Amount / Total Funds Sanctioned) × 100.
averageCostPerHouseholdD2DTooltip: Average cost per household for door-to-door waste collection services.
householdsCoveredD2DTooltip: Total number of households covered under door-to-door waste collection services.
gpsWithAssetGapsTooltip: Number of Gram Panchayats where asset gaps have been identified.
activeSanitationBiddersTooltip: Number of active bidders/contractors participating in sanitation and waste management tenders.
amountInLakhsConversionTooltip: Converts monetary amounts from Rupees to Lakhs for better readability.
totalSchemeTargetTooltip: Sum of all individual SBMG scheme targets.
totalSchemeAchievementTooltip: Sum of all individual SBMG scheme achievements.
totalGpsTooltip: At State/District level: Total count of Gram Panchayats (GPs). At Block level: Total count of Villages.
gpsWithDataTooltip: Number of GPs/Villages that have master data available.
inspectionOverallScoreTooltip: Overall inspection performance score (0-100%). Formula: (Total Points Earned / 180) × 100.
inspectionHouseholdWasteScoreTooltip: Score for household waste management (out of 50 points).
inspectionRoadCleaningScoreTooltip: Score for road cleaning frequency (out of 10 points).
inspectionDrainCleaningScoreTooltip: Score for drain cleaning and maintenance (out of 30 points).
inspectionCommunitySanitationScoreToolti: Score for community sanitation complex management (out of 40 points).
inspectionOtherScoreTooltip: Score for other inspection factors (out of 50 points).
averageInspectionScoreTooltip: Average score across all inspections conducted.
criticalIssuesTooltip: Number of critical issues identified during inspections.
averageResolutionTimeTooltip: Average time taken to resolve complaints.
totalComplaintsTooltip: Total number of complaints registered in the system.
resolvedComplaintsTooltip: Number of complaints that have been successfully resolved.
pendingComplaintsTooltip: Number of complaints that are still pending.
totalRatingsTooltip: Total number of feedback ratings submitted.
performanceTrendTooltip: Shows the trend in performance metrics over time.
defaultTooltip: Hover for more information about this metric.
